name: Xing Chen
tagline: ML Researcher · Deep Reinforcement Learning · Quantitative Trading  · LLM
motto: Make things simple and effective, not only in reinforcement learning.
bio: I received my PhD in Artificial Intelligence from Jilin University, where I worked on deep reinforcement learning — off-policy analysis of policy optimization, exploration for continuous control, and RLHF — including a visit to NTU's CCDS working with Prof. Bo An. I now lead an ML team at Ragentile Intelligence, focusing on LLM post-training and infrastructure speedup, with a continuing interest in RL for quantitative trading.
blog_intro: Notes on reinforcement learning, optimization, and quantitative trading.
